title: Tax & Inheritance Agent: 13 EU Countries | Virtuse
description: Bitcoin tax rules for 13 EU countries with official sources, and a check of how ready your Bitcoin is for your heirs. As of Q3 2026. Not tax advice.
og_title: Tax & Inheritance Agent: Bitcoin tax in 13 EU countries
h1_or: and a plan for your heirs.
lead: Pick your country to see how a Bitcoin sale is taxed, with a link to the official source. Then check how ready your Bitcoin is if something happens to you.
noscript: Tax & Inheritance Agent needs JavaScript. You can read the Bitcoin tax guides instead.
s1_p: Gain tax, holding-period exemption and how to file, each with its official source and the date we checked it.
s2_p: Six short questions show whether your heirs could reach your Bitcoin. The score is out of 100.
s3_p: The weakest points come first, with what to do about each. Confirm tax questions with a local advisor.
q1: Where do the tax rules come from?
a1: From the tax authority or the law of each country, linked next to every rule with the date we checked it. As of Q3 2026.
a2: No. It is an overview to help you ask the right questions. Rules change; confirm your case with a local tax advisor.
a3: No. The inheritance check runs in your browser and nothing you answer is sent to Virtuse.
a4: 13 EU countries. A country is shown only when its rules have an official source.
rel_rep_p: Tools that build your tax report.
rel_cfo_p: Check for free what you left out of your decision. The CFO then tracks fees and risks.
disclaimer: As of Q3 2026. Not tax or legal advice. Virtuse never holds your keys or funds.
